architecture: locked synthetic ActionDatabase and ActionPool containing four deterministic ScriptRule instances; no Architecture, Funcdata, address space, instruction bytes, or P-code graph is consumed
compiler_spec: not applicable: selective Action/Rule clone and registration-index state only

analysis_options.entrypoint: Production ActionDatabase::setCurrent -> deriveAction -> virtual ActionPool::clone, with rules added through production ActionPool::addRule; Rust invokes the mapped ActionDatabase and ActionPool methods
analysis_options.prestate: The registered universal pool has four rules in fixed order and three groups. Pool and Rule flags, status, breakpoints, and statistics are deliberately dirty before derivation; each Rule clone constructs a fresh instance from its constructor configuration.
analysis_options.observation: 27 fixed-order records covering the source, all-group clone, custom-group clone, and empty/null clone. Every non-null record includes pool state, full rule order and state, each rule opcode order, and per-opcode rule order.
analysis_options.normalization: No rule, opcode, state field, or order is normalized. Pointer identity is observed only as a cached-same boolean; raw addresses are not printed.
analysis_options.exception_policy: All group names exist and all operations satisfy their defined preconditions. Missing group/base exceptions are outside this projection; empty filtering is defined and covered as a cached null result.

analysis_options.pool: name universal; flags repeatapply|onceperfunc|warnings_given; dirty status_mid, break_start|break_action, tests=17, apply=11
analysis_options.rules: a(alpha,COPY+INT_ADD,ctor debug), b(beta,INT_ADD), c(alpha,COPY,ctor warnings_on), d(gamma,INT_SUB+COPY); every source runtime is disabled+warnings_on+warnings_given with distinct breakpoint/tests/apply
analysis_options.groups: all={alpha,beta,gamma}; custom={alpha,gamma}; empty={} in this invocation order
analysis_options.observation: map-entry/null/cache identity, complete pool/rule runtime fields, allrules order, getOpList order, and COPY/INT_ADD/INT_SUB perop order

cases: source: dirty pool and dirty rules in registration order
all: every Rule survives and is a fresh constructor instance
custom: beta is removed without reordering a/c/d or their opcode indices
empty: no Rule survives, clone is null, and the null actionmap entry is cached

observation_schema.format: 27 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with a final newline
observation_schema.perop: COPY, INT_ADD, and INT_SUB vectors in addRule append order
observation_schema.database: derived key presence, repeated-derive cache identity, and current root name

build.cpp_oracle: The complete locked decompiler C++ subtree is exported to a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt before linking the fixture.
build.private_state_observer: The fixture pre-includes the standard library, then scopes class/private/protected visibility macros to action.hh so it can observe ActionPool's implicit-private vectors and Action/Rule state without altering production bodies.
build.rust_comparand: A tar snapshot of pinned Rugra base 1b859f2 is materialized, only src/action.rs is overlaid, and the fixture is compiled as a temporary Cargo bin offline/locked under /tmp/rugra-cargo-build.lock with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rugra-target-actionpool-clone-filter.
build.drift_check: All owned source, documentation, fixture, metadata, and runner files are hashed before and after execution.

coverage.fresh_rule_clone: MATCH: dirty source flags/breakpoint/statistics are replaced by each Rule constructor's initial flags and zero runtime state
coverage.lazy_null_pool: MATCH: the pool is allocated only after the first surviving Rule and empty selection produces a cached null map entry
coverage.allrules_order: MATCH: all and custom selections retain source registration order without sorting or deduplication
coverage.perop_order: MATCH: clone registration rebuilds COPY/INT_ADD/INT_SUB vectors by appending each surviving Rule in allrules order; each Rule's getOpList order is retained
coverage.pool_state: MATCH: pool name and raw Action flags are copied while status, breakpoint, count_tests, and count_apply are constructor-fresh
coverage.derive_registered_base: MATCH: ActionDatabase clones the actual synthetic object registered as universal and caches both non-null and null results
coverage.group_boundaries: MATCH: all, proper custom subset, and empty group sets are observed
coverage.module_completion: NOT CLAIMED: ActionPool::apply still lacks full disabled/warning/breakpoint/op_state/rule_index behavior and retains separate live-op/dead-op differences

residuals: Concrete production Rule files do not yet override clone_for_groups; action.rs retains equivalent fresh constructors and groups at their locked registration slots to stay within this task's write-set.

The RuleIdentityEl implementation integrated separately at 5261aaa is in this change's successor caller closure through oppool1's coreaction.cc:5527 analysis-group constructor slot, but this synthetic clone fixture does not rerun RuleIdentityEl's own behavior oracle.
ActionPool::apply does not yet carry Ghidra per-Rule disabled/warning/breakpoint state or breakpoint-resume op_state/rule_index.
ActionPool::apply still uses a live-op Vec snapshot and has separately documented dead-op behavior differences.
Missing group/base exception text and ActionDatabase toggle/cloneGroup mutations are not exercised by this fixture.
